# Re-parse real_content with proper \r\n handling
lines = real_content.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip().split('\n')
header = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]
print(f"Columns: {header}")
print(f"Total data rows: {len(lines) - 1}\n")

won_james = []
won_sofia = []

for line in lines[1:]:
    parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
    deal_id = parts[0]
    rep_name = parts[1]
    region = parts[2]
    product = parts[3]
    amount = int(parts[4])
    close_date = parts[5]
    status = parts[6]

    if status == "won":
        entry = {"deal_id": deal_id, "rep": rep_name, "region": region,
                 "product": product, "amount": amount, "close_date": close_date}
        if rep_name == "James Okafor":
            won_james.append(entry)
        elif rep_name == "Sofia Delgado":
            won_sofia.append(entry)

print("=" * 80)
print("WON DEALS — James Okafor")
print("=" * 80)
james_total = 0
for d in won_james:
    flag = " ◀ HIGHLIGHTED" if d["deal_id"] in ["D001", "D006"] else ""
    print(f"  {d['deal_id']}  |  {d['product']:<25}  |  {d['region']:<6}  |  {d['close_date']}  |  ${d['amount']:>10,}{flag}")
    james_total += d["amount"]
print(f"  {'':>6}  {'':>25}     {'':>6}     {'Subtotal':>10}     ${james_total:>10,}")
print(f"  Won deals count: {len(won_james)}")

print()
print("=" * 80)
print("WON DEALS — Sofia Delgado")
print("=" * 80)
sofia_total = 0
for d in won_sofia:
    flag = " ◀ HIGHLIGHTED" if d["deal_id"] == "D005" else ""
    print(f"  {d['deal_id']}  |  {d['product']:<25}  |  {d['region']:<6}  |  {d['close_date']}  |  ${d['amount']:>10,}{flag}")
    sofia_total += d["amount"]
print(f"  {'':>6}  {'':>25}     {'':>6}     {'Subtotal':>10}     ${sofia_total:>10,}")
print(f"  Won deals count: {len(won_sofia)}")

print()
print("=" * 80)
print("VERIFICATION — Requested Deal Values")
print("=" * 80)
target_deals = {"D001": 87500, "D006": 120000, "D005": 55000}
all_won = won_james + won_sofia
for tid, expected_val in target_deals.items():
    match = [d for d in all_won if d["deal_id"] == tid]
    if match:
        actual = match[0]["amount"]
        status = "✅ CONFIRMED" if actual == expected_val else f"❌ MISMATCH (actual: ${actual:,})"
        print(f"  {tid}  |  Rep: {match[0]['rep']:<20}  |  Q3 Value: ${actual:>10,}  |  {status}")
    else:
        print(f"  {tid}  |  NOT FOUND among Won deals")

print(f"\nCombined Won Total (James + Sofia): ${james_total + sofia_total:,}")
